content: GitHub Actions has no first-class local execution; community tool nektos/act approximates runners in Docker with known gaps (environment mismatch, incomplete reusable-workflow/context support, caching/artifact differences); GitHub shipped 'gh act' local execution in preview (Linux-only initially). Mitigations: keep workflow YAML thin and put logic in scripts/make targets runnable identically locally; lint workflows statically with actionlint before pushing; use workflow_dispatch for targeted triggers. (Community synthesis, not primary-verified this run.)
